Kamui
A mystery box? So you don't know what's inside either?
I don't.
Kamui
Oh, the anticipation! What do you think it will be?
Smiling cheerfully, Kamui tears open the wrapping paper and reveals a corner of the box.
Kamui
PST5000! This is the portable game console they just released not too long ago! I signed up multiple times and still couldn't get in the queue! COM-MAN-DANT!
Kamui's eyes glisten excitedly—this seems to be exactly what he wants. Still, you are amazed to find the rare gaming device considered by the Astrology Club...
But then, Kamui's smile freezes—he opens the box of the PST5000 to find a much flatter box.
His expression is going on a rollercoaster ride right now. Taking out the box, he is brimming with joy again.
Kamui
It's "Spacefield"! This game is right on top of my wishlist! Commandant, my heart is beating so fast, and I don't even have a heart.
My heart almost stops beating, on the other hand.
Kamui
But! I'm glad it's Spacefield instead. I was kinda worried about what to give you back just then. The PST5000 is way too expensive, after all.
Kamui opens the box and indeed finds a game cartridge inside, except... something does not look right.
He takes it out and finds a small sticker on it that says, "Deep Space Exploration, A Documentary—Remastered 2.0".
Kamui
...This is a terrible prank, Commandant! You have to sign up for the PST5000 ordering queue with me as compensation!
Kamui
Deep Space Exploration... that sounds pretty interesting too. Let's watch it together next time!
Sure. I'll go sign up now...
